 Job Description: 

 Job Summary

•    Providing direct advisory services to customers on portfolio construction and portfolio review; 
•    Ensuring SCB offers a differentiated, best-in-class, consistent advisory proposition across customer segments. 
•    This will primarily involve providing professional expert advice to customers using the SCB advisory process for asset allocation, portfolio construction and portfolio review based on the full understanding of the customer's financial position, objectives, risk tolerance and other circumstances (but not including tax status). 
•    The Investment Advisor also acts as a subject matter expert to customers/frontline staff on holistic view of the market, and support SCB wealth strategy in providing to higher value customers a higher level of customer service, and growing recurring income faster than the transaction-based income 

Key Responsibilities

•    Portfolio/Investment Construction and Review for Assigned Customers 
•    Partner with 8-12 relationship managers RMs and act as an investment advisor to assigned customers of those RMs. For IAs Priority Banking, we would seek to provide this portfolio review service to at least the top 25% of Priority customers - as a guideline customer with combined Deposits+WM AUM of $200k & above.] 
•    Grow AUM of customers through investment advisory services, by proposing customer-specific portfolio solutions that will drive net growth in customer portfolios. 
•    Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
•    Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
•    Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank  
•    Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
•    Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
•    Fully comply with all the regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, uphold the robust mindset of Consumer Rights Protection, complete the Consumer Rights Protection themed training and workshop in due course, prevent the potential infringements of consumer rights, participate the public education, EV or other activities to uplift the public awareness about Consumer Rights Protection 

Strategy
•    Based on materials issued by Group and Country Investment Advisory and Strategy teams, provide market briefings for RMs/branches/Hubs 
•    Based on materials issued by Group and Country Wealth Solutions teams, provide updates on investment advisory process changes to RMs 

Business
•    Portfolio/Investment Diagnostics to Assigned RMs
•    Conduct one-on-one diagnostic reviews with each assigned RM on his/her portfolio at least once a month, to: 
        •    Align customer portfolios with their investment objectives, and aligning portfolios with house views 
        •    Balance asset allocation and thematic plays 

Processes
•    Provide investment consultation in the customers’ best interests using the SCB advisory process, rather than focussing on the sale of specific products. 
•    Help the customer to achieve his or her objectives, in the context of the customer's current needs/circumstances, in compliance with all regulatory and bank requirements and with the highest professional standards.

 Job Description: 

 Job Summary

We are seeking an energetic and commercially minded FX professional with a winning mindset and a strong ambition to build a career in foreign exchange advisory and dealing. In this high-impact role, you will deliver timely market insights, tailored FX strategies, and high-quality execution services to Private Wealth and Private Banking clients. You will also collaborate with relationship managers, investment advisors, sales professionals, traders, analysts, strategists, and economists—giving you broad exposure across the investment community and the opportunity to help grow a strategically important business.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute long-term strategic and tactical plans to capture FX business opportunities across the Bank’s Hong Kong franchise.

Grow the FX client base by delivering professional advisory, distribution, and execution services to Private Banking clients and Relationship Managers.

Provide timely market updates, actionable FX insights, and tailored investment or trading strategies to clients and key internal stakeholders, including Relationship Managers, Investment Advisors, and DAC.

Drive achievement of CMPS FX Hong Kong revenue targets through proactive client engagement, product advisory, and execution support.

Build trusted partnerships with Front Office teams, Relationship Managers, Investment Advisors, DAC, and other key business partners.

Lead FX product ideation, structuring, feature enhancement, service improvement, and operational upgrade initiatives to strengthen the client proposition and product competitiveness.

Monitor business performance, competitor activity, and key performance indicators to identify growth opportunities and recommend timely actions.

Ensure all FX advisory and execution activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, control standards, and best execution principles.

Ideal candidate

A university degree; professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, or CPA would be an advantage.

Six to eight years of relevant experience in financial markets, sales, advisory, or dealing; hands-on FX dealing experience is preferred.

Strong understanding of the wealth management industry, gained within Private Banking or Retail Banking.

Sound knowledge of FX markets, investment products, client advisory, and execution practices.

Strong commercial awareness, relationship-management skills, and the ability to translate market developments into relevant client opportunities.

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Fluency in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin.

Skills and Experience

FX advisory, dealing, and execution

Portfolio theory and asset allocation

Investment products, processes, and structuring

Relationship management and client engagement

Retail and Private Banking credit risk

Regulatory frameworks and requirements, including SIF

Strong computer skills; knowledge of Excel macros would be an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

 Job Description: 

Coverage Banking Graduate Programme 2027

Join our Coverage Banking team and help build and deepen relationships with some of the world’s leading corporates, financial institutions, investors and public sector clients. As the client-facing arm of the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) franchise, Coverage Banking sits at the centre of our client relationships, bringing together product expertise, sector insights and market connectivity to deliver holistic banking solutions.

With a unique footprint across Asia, Africa, the Middle East, Europe and the Americas, you’ll gain exposure to global clients, cross-border transactions and strategic conversations that shape industries, economies and communities. From supporting capital raising and financing solutions to helping clients navigate growth, transformation and market opportunities, you’ll play a role in delivering outcomes that matter.

About the Graduate Programme – how you’ll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You’ll benefit from:

Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes. 

Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.

Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions.

Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience.

Where you could work

You’ll be placed into one of the following teams, working as an Associate Coverage Banker supporting senior bankers in managing client relationships, coordinating deal execution and identifying opportunities across the Bank’s network.

Corporate Coverage: Partner with multinational corporations, large local corporates and mid-market clients across a broad range of industries. You’ll help deliver banking solutions spanning financing, cash management, trade, capital markets and strategic advisory services, while supporting relationship teams in driving client growth and franchise deepening.

Financial Institutions Coverage: Support relationships with banks, insurance companies, asset managers, sovereign entities, public sector organisations and other financial institutions. You’ll gain exposure to complex client needs across financing, risk management, transaction banking, securities services and investment solutions.

Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Support clients through significant moments of transformation, including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll gain exposure to transaction execution, financial analysis, industry research and deal processes while working closely with sector bankers and product specialists.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re looking for people who can:

Take ownership and demonstrate initiative.

Think critically and solve problems in a structured way.

Learn quickly and adapt to new challenges, seeking opportunities to grow and develop

Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others

Communicate confidently and collaborate across different cultures and backgrounds.

Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in global markets, industries and clients.

Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced and international environment.

For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance & Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics. 

Eligibility

With our unique international footprint, you’ll gain exposure to cross-border business, global clients and real-world banking challenges. You’ll work across teams, products and geographies while developing the commercial, analytical and relationship-building skills that underpin a successful career in banking.
Join us if you’re curious about how businesses grow, how financial markets operate and how trusted client relationships are built.

About the Internship Programme – how you’ll learn and grow  

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background.  Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.

The programme will support your development through:

•    A 10-week summer internship  
•    A structured induction and orientation  
•    Exposure to our products, clients and international network
•    Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
•    Technical, professional and behavioural skills development

Corporate Coverage: Support relationship teams managing multinational corporations, large local corporates and mid-market clients. You’ll gain exposure to financing solutions, transaction banking, capital markets activities and strategic client engagement while learning how long-term client relationships are developed and managed.

Financial Institutions Coverage: Work with teams covering banks, insurance companies, asset managers, sovereign entities and other financial institutions. You’ll gain insight into how financial institutions access financing, manage risk and utilise the Bank’s global capabilities to support their businesses.

Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Gain exposure to landmark transactions including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll support research, analysis and deal execution activities while learning how clients navigate transformational business decisions.

Coverage Banking Internship Programme 2027 

Join our Coverage Banking team and gain first-hand experience supporting some of the world’s leading corporates, financial institutions, investors and public sector clients. As part of the client-facing arm of Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), you’ll work alongside experienced bankers to help deliver integrated banking solutions, build client relationships and support strategic growth opportunities across markets.
With our unique international footprint, you’ll gain exposure to cross-border business, global clients and real-world banking challenges. You’ll work across teams, products and geographies while developing the commercial, analytical and relationship-building skills that underpin a successful career in banking.
Join us if you’re curious about how businesses grow, how financial markets operate and how trusted client relationships are built.

About the Internship Programme – how you’ll learn and grow  

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background.  Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.

The programme will support your development through:

•    A 10-week summer internship  
•    A structured induction and orientation  
•    Exposure to our products, clients and international network
•    Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
•    Technical, professional and behavioural skills development
•    Support from managers, mentors and buddies
•    Opportunities to learn from senior leaders and industry experts
•    Community and volunteering initiatives.

Where you could work 

You will be placed into one of the following Coverage Banking teams, working alongside experienced bankers to support client relationships, business development activities and transaction execution across our global franchise.

Corporate Coverage: Support relationship teams managing multinational corporations, large local corporates and mid-market clients. You’ll gain exposure to financing solutions, transaction banking, capital markets activities and strategic client engagement while learning how long-term client relationships are developed and managed.

Financial Institutions Coverage: Work with teams covering banks, insurance companies, asset managers, sovereign entities and other financial institutions. You’ll gain insight into how financial institutions access financing, manage risk and utilise the Bank’s global capabilities to support their businesses.

Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Gain exposure to landmark transactions including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll support research, analysis and deal execution activities while learning how clients navigate transformational business decisions.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career 

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We’re looking for people who can:

•    Take ownership and show initiative.
•    Think critically and solve problems using logic and sound judgement.
•    Learn quickly, stay curious and seek opportunities to grow.
•    Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others.
•    Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment.
•    Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, industries and global markets.
•    Communicate confidently and work effectively across different cultures and backgrounds.
